static_atomicity_audit.timing_observation: event_pair_tag now reaches output-valid/data quarantine and sequential commit enables in the same cycle; DC reports high-fanout nets and reduced setup slack versus r1

matched_dc_recalc.boundary: full-flop, zero-macro, pre-layout logic-only DC; W3072 hold rounds to 0.0000 ns and cannot support physical PPA

allowed_claims: The exact M231r2 snapshot passes four-width directed VCS for ordinary paths and the two tested protocol attacks, including same-cycle quarantine with zero externally advertised accepts.
An independent W384 reproduction of the old concurrent wrong-tag/raw-ready attack observes protocol_error=1, all accepts=0, raw_packet_count delta=0, and preserved pending drain state.
Matched 3 ns TSMC28 pre-macro DC meets nonnegative setup and hold in all four configurations, with the reported full-flop areas and explicit ZeroWireload/0-macro boundary.
Relative to revoked r1 DC, the correction changes cell area by -0.73% to +0.10%, keeps sequential-cell count unchanged, and reduces setup slack at every width.
forbidden_claims: Do not cite the original M231 r1 VCS or DC as current RTL admission.
Do not claim exhaustive protocol proof, Formality, mapped-netlist equivalence, PT STA, SAIF, PTPX, SRAM implementation, energy, or paper-ready PPA.
Do not claim an executable or deadlock-free M167-to-M231-to-M216/M218 path, finite frozen-trace cycle gain, or achieved 875.52 MB traffic elimination.
Do not claim PAFT/M167 dynamic-BN accuracy, complete FFN speedup, system speedup, headline speedup, or DATE-level end-to-end performance.

P0.title: Executable admitted producer-to-consumer chain remains absent
P0.detail: The atomicity correction closes old M231-P0-01 only. M167 rank3/dynamic-BN accuracy, typed producer metadata, M216/M218 consumption, finite two-slot recurrence, and ordered 120-record execution remain unclosed; old M231-P0-02 therefore survives unchanged.

P1.title: Adversarial verification remains directed and narrow
P1.detail: Production VCS tests one idle orphan and one wrong-tag/raw-ready collision per width. Wrong group, wrong last, malformed traffic in every phase, reset during fill/drain, counter rollover, and simultaneous slot turnover are not systematically covered.

P1.title: No formal or post-synthesis functional closure
P1.detail: There is no Formality, mapped-netlist VCS, or equivalent proof that r2 preserves all ordinary r1 behavior while adding quarantine.

P1.title: Physical storage and power remain outside evidence
P1.detail: The bridge is entirely full-flop in DC, with zero macros and ZeroWireload; there is no SRAM bank/port model, PT STA, SAIF, or PTPX.

P1.title: Atomic quarantine adds a timing-sensitive high-fanout control cone
P1.detail: DC critical paths now start at event_pair_tag and reach counters or raw outputs, setup slack decreases by 0.0269 to 0.4759 ns versus r1, and high-fanout warnings remain. W3072 hold rounds to 0.0000 ns.

P1.title: Cross-module no-combinational-loop rule is not contracted
P1.detail: No loop exists inside M231r2 and DC loop checks pass, but event_ready depends on current event_valid/payload legality. The future M167 adapter must guarantee valid/payload independence from ready and close interface timing.

P1.title: Correction contract is a pre-admission snapshot
P1.detail: Its corrected_vcs and corrected_synopsys_dc fields remain false. The sealed r2 receipts plus this review support scoped admission, but a dedicated immutable admission overlay would make citation less ambiguous.

P1.title: Fault recovery and liveness are reset-only
P1.detail: The current contract intentionally freezes pending state after fault until reset. Reset recovery under every fill/drain phase and downstream retry semantics have not been exercised.

P2.title: Fault cover name overstates its predicate
P2.detail: cp_fault_while_raw_would_accept covers protocol_error&&raw_ready, not the hidden pre-quarantine drain_raw condition. The independent hierarchical TB supplies that missing observation for W384 only.

P2.title: DC emits type and parameter-fold warnings
P2.detail: Signed-to-unsigned conversion, unreachable case branches, and ignored parameter-guard $fatal warnings are benign for supported widths but should be cleaned before final RTL freeze.

P2.title: Deterministic data and stalls limit state-space coverage
P2.detail: Changing the VCS random seed does not randomize the production payload or ready pattern.

P2.title: Cell count is not a stable optimization metric
P2.detail: W1536 cell count falls 7.58% while area falls only 0.73%; use cell area and timing, not raw gate count, for r1/r2 comparison.

minimum_next_milestone.name: M231r3 typed finite-trace composite
requirements: Freeze the M167 BACK to M231 header/group/last adapter and its no-combinational-ready dependency contract.
Instantiate M231 with the M216 ingress and extend to M218 service or an exact consumer miter.
Execute the ordered 120-record payload through finite two-slot backpressure and report cycles, stalls, transactions, and deadlock/liveness separately.
Add systematic malformed-event/reset/slot-turnover tests and Formality or mapped-netlist equivalence.
Keep dynamic-BN accuracy, SRAM, energy, complete FFN, system, and headline claims false until their own evidence closes.
